answer: When a person takes photos forms a cadence tied to their daily routine and habits. A farm needs 226 distinct cadences, since one routine cannot describe 226 people's photo habits. The cadence is measured from fresh capture timestamps each epoch, and a bot's uniform pattern stands out.
